candidates.source_name: e-Prokurimi — Kosovo national e-procurement portal (SPIN_PROD)
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory national portal where every contracting authority (incl. Ministry of Finance/Treasury, BQK, FSDK, KCGF, Trusti) publishes contract notices (B05) and contract award notices (B08). Award notices name the winning economic operator, contract value and CPV, so tenders for banking services, card/POS terminals, payment processing and core-banking maintenance directly reveal supplier wins and the personnel/qualification requirements those contracts impose.
candidates.access_status: public, no login for notice viewing; login required to bid
candidates.legal_status: official public-sector publication, mandatory publication regime
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of the notice document pages (pattern observed: /SPIN_PROD/application/ipn/DocumentManagement/DokumentPodaciFrm.aspx?id=NNNNNNN) plus CPV-filtered notice search; parse B05/B08 PDFs for authority, supplier, value, dates.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from notice PDFs
queries_used: e-prokurimi Kosovë njoftim kontrate shërbime bankare
KRPP Kosovo procurement notice payment processing services contract award
"njoftim për dhënie të kontratës" Kosovë terminale POS ose "shërbime bankare" 2025

candidates.source_name: KRPP / Komisioni Rregullativ i Prokurimit Publik (Public Procurement Regulatory Commission)
candidates.why_relevant: Regulator that operates e-Prokurimi, maintains the authoritative list of contracting authorities and publishes annual public-procurement reports. The contracting-authority list is the master actor map for which public financial bodies must tender; the annual reports aggregate contract volumes and top suppliers — a pointer into supplier names and institutional structure.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual fetch of raportet vjetore PDFs and the 'Lista e Autoriteteve Kontraktuese' page; diff the authority list year-over-year to detect new/merged public bodies.
queries_used: KRPP raporti vjetor prokurimi publik Kosovë krpp.rks-gov.net lista e autoriteteve kontraktuese

candidates.source_name: AQP / Agjencia Qendrore e Prokurimit (Central Procurement Agency)
candidates.why_relevant: Runs centralised/framework procurements on behalf of central institutions, including cross-government service contracts. Framework contracts for banking, card and payment-related services would be awarded here rather than by an individual ministry, so it is the place where a single supplier win covers many public bodies.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the agency's notice/announcement listing and cross-reference the corresponding e-Prokurimi notice IDs.
queries_used: e-prokurimi Kosovë njoftim kontrate shërbime bankare

candidates.source_name: OSHP / Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit (Procurement Review Body)
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes binding decisions on bidder complaints. Decisions narrate who bid, who lost and why — an unusually rich, adversarial disclosure of the payments/IT supplier field around public financial institutions, including technical and staffing qualification disputes. Also publishes a blacklist of excluded operators.
candidates.legal_status: official decisions of a public body
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the decisions listing and the ComplaintByBlackList report; keyword-filter decision PDFs for bank/payment/POS/card CPV terms and for the names of MF, Thesari, BQK, FSDK, KCGF, Trusti.
queries_used: Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit OSHP Kosovë vendim ankesë shërbime bankare

candidates.source_name: OSHP decisions mirror — oshp.dplus.org (civil-society searchable database)
candidates.why_relevant: A third-party structured/searchable mirror of Procurement Review Body decisions, typically far easier to query than the official site. Useful as a fallback and for bulk keyword search across years of decisions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword search / scrape of the decisions index; verify anything material against the official OSHP copy.
queries_used: Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit OSHP Kosovë vendim ankesë shërbime bankare

candidates.source_name: Ministria e Financave, Punës dhe Transfereve (MFPT) — official site
candidates.why_relevant: The ministry that owns Treasury, tax and public financial management. Publishes vacancy notices (konkurse), procurement notices, organigram/structure changes and senior appointments. Its Treasury department is the counterparty for government payment/banking arrangements, so its staffing and reorganisations are leading indicators of public payment-system change.
candidates.access_status: public; site navigation not fully resolvable via plain fetch
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl news/announcement and 'konkurse'/'prokurimi' sections; supplement with the SIMBNJ vacancy portal which carries the legally binding version of civil-service konkurse.
queries_used: Ministria e Financave Kosovë Thesari konkurs pune zyrtar
local_language_terms_used: Ministria e Financave, Punës dhe Transfereve

candidates.source_name: SIMBNJ — konkursi.rks-gov.net (Kosovo civil-service recruitment portal)
candidates.why_relevant: The single mandatory electronic portal for Kosovo civil-service vacancy notices, shortlists and named winners across all central institutions including the Ministry of Finance and Treasury. This is the highest-yield structured source for A5 public-sector hiring signals: role titles (e.g. Zyrtar i Pagesave in Divizioni i Pagesave), unit names, and the identity of appointed officials.
candidates.access_status: public listing; some flows may require account
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily scrape of the vacancy listing filtered by institution (MFPT, Thesari) and by keywords pagesa/thesar/bankar/TI; also capture the results/winner announcements which name appointees.

negative_findings.description: The e-Prokurimi homepage fetch did not expose a discoverable notice-search or award-notice browse URL; only a news archive and a contracting-authority list link were resolvable. Individual notices are reachable only via opaque numeric IDs (DokumentPodaciFrm.aspx?id=NNNNNNN).
negative_findings.result_summary: Notice-level browsing endpoint not identified from the homepage; ID-based deep links confirmed to exist. This is a hypothesis about the site structure, not evidence the search function is absent — an authenticated or JS-driven search UI very likely exists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector will probably need ID enumeration, sitemap discovery or a headless-browser session rather than a simple listing crawl; effort estimate for the highest-value source in this cell should be raised accordingly.

negative_findings.description: Targeted searches for Kosovo public tenders specifically naming POS terminals, card acquiring or payment-processing services (sq: 'terminale POS', 'shërbime të procesimit të pagesave') returned no matching award notice.
negative_findings.result_summary: No POS/acquiring-specific public contract award notice was found in open web search. The closest confirmed payments-infrastructure procurement is BQK's 'TIPS Clone Connectivity Services' contract award notice (instant payments), found on bqk-kos.org.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests such procurements are either rare, bundled under generic 'shërbime bankare' or IT CPV codes, or only visible inside e-Prokurimi's search — meaning keyword monitoring must use CPV codes and broad Albanian terms, not English payments jargon.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for Kosovo public financial institutions' vacancies and tenders was heavily polluted by Republic of Serbia institutions (mfin.gov.rs, trezor.gov.rs, mup.rs) that share the exact same terminology.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only one genuinely Kosovo-based sr-language public vacancy source was confirmed (Posta e Kosovës 'Javni Konkurs Za Radno Mesto'). No sr-language vacancy or tender page was confirmed on the sites of MFPT, FSDK, KCGF or Trusti, though the Public Procurement Rules require preliminary notices in Albanian, Serbian and English.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: sr is a mandated official language in Kosovo, so sr-language notices should exist; failing to find them via general search means the collector must go to the institution sites' sr language toggles directly. Also flags 'Ministarstvo finansija', 'Trezor', 'javne nabavke', 'konkurs' as high-noise terms requiring a site: or geographic qualifier ('Kosovo', 'Priština', 'rks-gov.net').

negative_findings.description: A plain fetch of mf.rks-gov.net (Ministry of Finance, Labour and Transfers) did not return the site's menu URLs for konkurse, prokurimi, Thesari or organizational structure.
negative_findings.result_summary: Homepage content rendered without resolvable section links; likely a JS-driven menu. Treated as unverified, not dead — the ministry site is clearly live and referenced by other official sources.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The ministry site needs a browser-based or sitemap-based crawl; in the interim, konkursi.rks-gov.net and kosovajob.com cover its vacancy flow.

negative_findings.description: No single official page was located that lists appointments/dismissals of senior Treasury (Thesari) officials, e.g. the Director of Treasury.
negative_findings.result_summary: The Official Gazette (gzk.rks-gov.net) is the likely repository for such government decisions but no appointment decision was retrieved via general search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-move detection for Treasury will require direct querying of the GZK act database plus media monitoring, rather than a ready-made feed.

coverage_gaps.description: The highest-value source in this cell (e-Prokurimi notice corpus) has no confirmed machine-readable listing or API; only ID-addressed notice pages were confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated technical reconnaissance pass on e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net with a headless browser: locate the notice-search form, capture its POST/query parameters and CPV filter values, and test whether notice IDs are densely sequential enough for enumeration. Consult the Open Contracting Partnership Kosovo assessment first.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of Kosovo public financial institutions' vacancy and tender notices is essentially unconfirmed apart from Posta e Kosovës.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Visit the sr language toggles of mf.rks-gov.net, fsdk.org, fondikgk.org, trusti.org and e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net directly and record the sr URL patterns; add 'site:rks-gov.net' and 'Priština/Kosovo' qualifiers to all sr queries to suppress Republic-of-Serbia noise.

coverage_gaps.description: Kosovo's other public/state-linked financial actors were not systematically enumerated in this pass — e.g. the Privatisation Agency, publicly owned enterprises with treasury functions, the Tax Administration (ATK) and Customs (Dogana) as payment-collecting bodies. Dogana was seen publishing its own B08 award notices.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Diff the KRPP 'Lista e Autoriteteve Kontraktuese' against the actors already tracked, and add any body whose mandate involves collecting, holding or disbursing public money.

coverage_gaps.description: Contract-implementation and payment-execution data (who was actually paid, how much, over what period) was not sourced; only notice-stage data was confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Investigate whether contract 'implementation cards' referenced by the Open Contracting Partnership assessment are individually downloadable from e-Prokurimi, and whether Treasury publishes supplier payment records (a common open-data disclosure).

coverage_gaps.description: Several institutional vacancy pages (FSDK, Trusti, KCGF) appear to publish notices as dated PDFs but it is unconfirmed whether expired notices remain archived, so retrospective hiring-trend reconstruction may be impossible from the primary sources alone.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test PDF-directory enumeration on fsdk.org, trusti.org and fondikgk.org (wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/) and begin snapshotting listing pages immediately so a forward-looking time series starts now; use kosovajob/duapune employer archives as the retrospective proxy.

brief: Kosovo's public route into banking/payments intelligence is unusually well-structured on paper: a single mandatory e-procurement portal (e-Prokurimi, run by KRPP) carries contract and award notices for every contracting authority, an appeals tribunal (OSHP) publishes adversarial decisions naming bidders, and a single mandatory civil-service portal (konkursi.rks-gov.net / SIMBNJ) carries every Ministry of Finance and Treasury vacancy with unit-level role titles. The independent public financial institutions — FSDK, KCGF, Trusti and BQK — each self-publish vacancies, tenders, board rosters and org charts on their own sites, with BQK's PDF store already yielding a payments-infrastructure award notice (TIPS clone connectivity), making it the strongest single pointer to national payment-system suppliers. The binding constraints are technical and linguistic rather than legal: e-Prokurimi exposes notices only through opaque numeric IDs with no confirmed search API, the Ministry of Finance site resists plain fetching, and Serbian-language coverage is almost entirely swamped by identically-named Republic of Serbia institutions despite sr being an official language. Practical strategy: treat konkursi.rks-gov.net, BQK's PDF store and the institutional careers/board pages as immediately collectable high-yield feeds, use job aggregators (KosovaJob, DuaPune, PunaIme/PortalPune) and mirrors (Prishtina Online, oshp.dplus.org) as low-friction early-warning surfaces, and invest a dedicated engineering pass in cracking e-Prokurimi's notice search.
